description: DRAFT (not registered). SQ207/X1 speller on a FROZEN A2s trunk (seed-2 checkpoint): only the byte decoder trains. H-C2F arm: shared-weight byte refinement, r_b = 2 (one lswa+SwiGLU block applied twice, contractive re-injection, per-pass loss 0.5).

computed.note: computed by gogeta.c2f (FusionDance's counting rule: 2 x params per application + attention/GDN terms, training = 3 x forward); per token; NOT measured
computed.reference: A2s BPE train FLOPs/token (same trunk + head)

notes: The global model's config and weights come from global_init (A2s = a3mx without MoE, 200M tokens on code-py-v2; its summary.json: val_loss 1.0910 nats/token, val_bits_per_char 0.4156). That val_loss is the bar: the decoder's val_loss on the same val = the trunk's own next-token information plus the spelling cost. The trunk runs forward-only (eval mode, its default 2 loops), so FLOPs/token = A2s forward without its head + 3 x decoder. global_init is this machine's path: a fleet box needs the same checkpoint (sha256 recorded in the run config). 20M tokens, lr 0.006 and warmup 100 are untuned guesses.
